page_title: LYO 1-0 MAR | Lyon v Marseille 31/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' A clever short pass gives Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
90+4' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Michael Murillo (Marseille) duly receives a yellow card.
90+2' That's the end of the game for Adam Karabec, who is replaced by Ruben Kluivert (Lyon).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' The ball finds its way to Pavel Sulc (Lyon) after a confusing situation inside the goalmouth. He finds some space and easily knocks the ball in with his body and alters the score to 1:0.
86' Hamed Junior Traore (Marseille) is being substituted because of an injury. Roberto De Zerbi sends Darryl Bakola on the pitch.
85' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Robinio Vaz (Marseille) replaces Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang.
84' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Geronimo Rulli comes off the line to clear the ball away.
80' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) has tested the patience of referee Francois Letexier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
78' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
77' Clinton Mata (Lyon) takes the free kick from the edge of the box and fires the ball goalwards. The goalkeeper can stay calm as the shot sails high over the bar.
77' Francois Letexier blows for a foul after Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Lyon are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
74' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.
72' Substitution. Timothy Weah makes his way off the pitch and Pol Lirola (Marseille) comes on as his replacement.
72' Tyler Morton (Lyon) takes the corner but it's cleared.
71' Jorge Maciel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Afonso Moreira (Lyon) replacing Abner Vinicius.
71' That will be all from Khalis Merah who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pavel Sulc (Lyon).

71' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
70' Marseille fail to score from a corner as Remy Descamps (Lyon) leaps to collect the ball.
69' What a sweet touch by Hamed Junior Traore (Marseille) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Remy Descamps to hold.
68' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) is desperate to score a goal, but he misses the target after striking the ball well wide of the left post.
64' Tyler Morton (Lyon) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
64' Adam Karabec (Lyon) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Now Lyon have a corner.

63' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the right side of the goal, but it wasn't dangerous and Remy Descamps made a comfortable save.
63' The corner kick from Tyler Morton (Lyon) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
62' Adam Karabec (Lyon) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Lyon.
60' The ball possession at the moment is 57:43.
60' Lyon hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
57' Adam Karabec (Lyon) commits a foul and Francois Letexier immediately signals a free kick.
55' A corner kick by Marseille is thwarted by the well prepared Remy Descamps (Lyon).
53' Jorge Maciel is forced to make a change. Malick Fofana (Lyon) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Nicolas Tagliafico.
52' Malick Fofana (Lyon) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
49' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Geronimo Rulli is equal to it and makes an easy save.
48' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
46' Roberto De Zerbi makes a half-time substitution. Ulisses Garcia comes on in place of Mason Greenwood (Marseille).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' Francois Letexier blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+7' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
45+7' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Francois Letexier due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) and his team.
45+6' Tyler Morton (Lyon) takes the corner.

45+6' Adam Karabec (Lyon) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lyon.
45+5' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45+3' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+3' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

45+3' Malick Fofana (Lyon) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the top of the net, but Geronimo Rulli made a superb athletic save to deny him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lyon are going to take it.
45+1' Clinton Mata (Lyon) makes a strong challenge and Francois Letexier blows for a foul.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
45' Adam Karabec (Lyon) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Lyon force their opponents to concede a corner.
43' Adam Karabec (Lyon) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
41' Today's referee Francois Letexier rightly decides to book Angel Gomes (Marseille) for his harsh tackle.

40' Geronimo Rulli makes a brilliant save! Malick Fofana (Lyon) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
38' Tyler Morton (Lyon) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
38' The ball is cleared after Tyler Morton (Lyon) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner.
37' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The linesman signals a throw-in for Marseille.
34' Tyler Morton (Lyon) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
34' The manager is forced to make a substitution due to a red card. Roberto De Zerbi issues instructions to Derek Cornelius (Marseille), who will replace Bilal Nadir.

34' That's unlucky! Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Lyon will take a corner kick.
31' Tyler Morton (Lyon) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
29' Khalis Merah (Lyon) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
29' CJ Egan-Riley (Marseille) takes out his opponent with an awful tackle and is shown a red card by the referee!
28' A goal, which was scored by Abner Vinicius (Lyon), was disallowed due to offside.
27' The game is interrupted as Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is flagged offside.
26' Hamed Junior Traore (Marseille) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

25' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Timothy Weah (Marseille). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Marseille force a corner. They send men into the box.
22' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
22' NO PENALTY! Referee Francois Letexier has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Lyon players are incensed.
21' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Lyon as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
20' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) brings an opponent down and Francois Letexier interrupts the game. PENALTY! One of the players from Lyon is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
20' Adam Karabec (Lyon) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lyon.

15' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Geronimo Rulli shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
14' Lyon take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
13' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Abner Vinicius (Lyon), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Lyon have a corner.
12' It looks like Tyler Morton (Lyon) saw red with that tackle. Francois Letexier won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
9' Marseille decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
8' The game is interrupted now, Angel Gomes (Marseille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
8' Tyler Morton (Lyon) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francois Letexier saw the whole situation. Marseille have a free kick.
7' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
6' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' Hamed Junior Traore (Marseille) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
5' Michael Murillo (Marseille) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
2' Francois Letexier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Angel Gomes (Marseille).
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Marseille will kick the game off.
Francois Letexier will referee today's match.
